scope: Only C32/F25 content updated; inspected owned source hashes and discovery entries recorded. Shared navigation changes inspected; removing only the owned insertion recovered the prior reviewed bytes for each of three shared documents.

before.title_zh: 测得反馈的机制与物理对应
before.title_en: Measured feedback mechanism and physical correspondence
before.claim_zh: 三次已发表物理运行的1794项命令由实际读数、积分和时距重建；从该机制导出行动误差项，并保留更多运动、未来误差界失败和优化源码的指标差异。
before.claim_en: All 1794 commands in three published physical runs are reconstructed from acquired readings, retained integral and elapsed time; the mechanism supplies a derived action-error term, retaining extra movement, failed future-bound extrapolation and an optimizer objective discrepancy.
before.scope_zh: 历史数据重分析和13项新Lean定理；不是新硬件试验、传感真值证明或伦理根据。完整三项整合目标仍活动，读数／响应校准和方案生成尚须整合。
before.scope_en: Archival reanalysis and 13 new Lean theorems; not a new hardware experiment, sensor-truth proof or ethical warrant. The overall three-part integration remains active, with calibration and candidate-generation contracts still to integrate.

before.title_zh: 反馈误差传递与运动指标实查
before.title_en: Checked feedback error transport and movement accounting
before.claim_zh: 实际控制器的实数模型把传感与记忆误差传到命令，再组合尺度误差定理；13项新定理、26项新声明、五模块共147项实查。另有1794命令的精确有理数数值复核。
before.claim_en: A real-number controller abstraction carries sensing and memory error into commands and composes the scale bounds: 13 new theorems, 26 declarations and 147 checks across five modules; a separate rational calculation checks 1794 commands.
before.scope_zh: Lean4.30.0-rc2新编仓库依赖，固定Mathlib缓存；标准逻辑依赖明示。独立验收重编147项审计、重放1794命令并独立QR复拟四模型；不是浮点程序的形式验证或新物理复制。
before.scope_en: Lean4.30.0-rc2 rebuilds repository dependencies with the pinned Mathlib cache and disclosed logical dependencies. Independent acceptance rebuilt 147 audits, replayed 1794 commands and refitted four models by QR; no formal floating-program refinement or new physical replication.

after.title_zh: 测得反馈的机制与物理对应
after.title_en: Measured feedback mechanism and physical correspondence
after.claim_zh: 先前1794项已发表物理命令的对应，现接通初始／读数误差、饱和分支、后续积分、命令与继承尺度界；真实数据上的完整控制器重算保留隐藏记忆跳变与宽界。
after.claim_en: The preceding correspondence for 1794 published physical commands now connects initial/readout error, saturation, later integral memory, commands and inherited scale bounds; whole controller recomputations retain hidden memory jumps and loose enclosures.
after.scope_zh: 后续记忆界由实际递推推得；新增13项定理和7176项精确重算，含三组不变对照，不新增物理试验。未来读数校准、物理响应／时距、方案生成与实践比较仍待接通。
after.scope_en: Later memory bounds follow from the actual recurrence: 13 additional theorems and 7176 exact recomputations, including three unchanged controls, without new physical trials. Future readout warrant, physical response/timing, candidate generation and practical comparison remain open.

after.title_zh: 反馈误差、保留记忆与历史比较
after.title_en: Feedback error, retained memory and history comparison
after.claim_zh: 先前13项反馈定理保留；另13项新定理／21项声明推导分支感知记忆界，实际组合原有受控过程误差界，并传递命令运动与暴露量误差。六模块共168项审计。
after.claim_en: The preceding 13 feedback theorems retain their scope; 13 additional theorems/21 declarations derive memory bounds through branch changes, compose the inherited plant bound, and transport movement/exposure errors. Six modules pass 168 audits.
after.scope_zh: 独立重编168项审计并逐字段复核7176项有理数证书。Lean4.30.0-rc2、固定Mathlib缓存及逻辑依赖明示；回溯读数变换不是未来校准或反事实热实验。
after.scope_en: Independent rebuild of 168 audits and field-by-field verification of 7176 rational certificates. Lean4.30.0-rc2, pinned Mathlib cache and logical dependencies disclosed; retrospective readout transformations are not future calibration or counterfactual thermal experiments.
